items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Joe was married to a very good singer, Babe Fay Matthews.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe was married to a very good singer, Babe Fay Matthews.

But Joe was a great trumpet player, too. Joe did some time with me during the Second World War, and then when Joe left, I forget why -- but I was fortunate enough to get Emmett Berry on trumpet. And he's a swinging trumpet player. And I think that was the band, when I left, I let the band go, and Barney Josephson started getting on me because I didn't rehearse the band. We were a jazz band, but he felt he wasn't getting his money's worth unless we rehearsed, and we were playing for him from eight o'clock at night…
